instruction: Use Chrome's shortcut tool to add a desktop shortcut for this webpage.

metadata.explanation: This variation creates a desktop shortcut for Stack Overflow. The task maintains the same workflow and difficulty level, requiring the creation of a Chrome desktop shortcut. The evaluator checks for the Stack Overflow app-id 'ijllcpnolfcooahcekpamkbidhejabll' in the desktop shortcut. Uses existing getters and metrics: get_shortcuts_on_desktop and is_shortcut_on_desktop.

Expected exec command '/opt/google/chrome/google-chrome --profile-directory=Default --app-id=ijllcpnolfcooahcekpamkbidhejabll' is semantically correct and specific to Stack Overflow
The app-id 'ijllcpnolfcooahcekpamkbidhejabll' correctly identifies Stack Overflow shortcuts created by Chrome's shortcut tool
Complete coverage: verifies shortcut exists, is on desktop, is for the correct webpage (Stack Overflow), and was created using Chrome's tool
Evaluation logic will work correctly at runtime - getter can access desktop files, metric can perform the string comparison
